couplets.en: I remembered my tearful eyes again, and the ache within me that longed to cry out.
I remembered my tearful eyes again.

lines: Zindagi yun bhi guzar hi jaati
couplets.en: Life would have gone by anyway.

lines: Zindagi yun bhi guzar hi jaati
couplets.en: Life would have gone by anyway, so why did I remember the road to you?
I remembered my tearful eyes again.

lines: Dasht ko dekh ke ghar yaad aaya
couplets.en: The wilderness was so desolate it put me in mind of home.
I remembered my tearful eyes again.
Where is the courage I once had to cry out?

lines: Dil se tang aa ke jigar yaad aaya
couplets.en: Where was my courage to cry out when, weary of my heart, I remembered what strength I once had?
I remembered my tearful eyes again, and the ache within me that longed to cry out.
I remembered my tearful eyes again.
